lines.3: The girl who had chased us stood over me with her feet planted wide.
lines.4: Her eyes looked down at me where I sat helpless on the ground.
lines.5: Her gaze was like a freshly honed blade.
lines.6: Judging from the uniform, the girl responsible for laying me out was an older third-year.
lines.7: With the spring sunlight at her back...
lines.10: She scolded me in that perfectly clear voice.
lines.11: She was above. I was below.
lines.12: It was a perfect picture of our relationship: her above, me below.
lines.13: A dignified expression. A commanding stance.
lines.14: Her neatly cropped hair stirred in the wind.
lines.15: She marched us back to the front gate.
lines.16: 「Otome Kurogane, Chair of Ryuumeikan Academy's Disciplinary Committee. I have administered summary punishment for your violations of school rules.」
lines.19: 「Page seventeen of the student handbook: Special Authority of the Disciplinary Committee. A committee member may punish any student who disobeys a caution or warning, provided that no injury is inflicted.」
lines.20: 「Grr... What do you mean, 'no injury'? You dropped me flat on my back... That seriously wasn't funny...」
lines.22: 「I pulled you upward just as you struck the ground. You should have felt the impact, but no pain.」
lines.23: 「Now then. What you did was a clear violation of school rules. You understand that, yes?」
lines.24: 「Students must enter and leave through the designated entrances when arriving at or departing from school. Students must not climb over the walls surrounding the school grounds. You violated both rules.」
lines.25: She lined all four of us up and began her lecture.
lines.26: 「I'm sorry! I tried to warn them, but they just wouldn't listen!」
lines.27: 「It was a moment of weakness! They're not bad people!」
lines.29: 「I'll give them a stern talking-to later, so we'll be going!」
lines.32: The disciplinary chair fixed Fukahire with a sharp stare.
lines.34: 「I have monitored your activities recently. You have committed a mountain of minor violations.」
lines.35: 「Oh! So that feeling of being watched was this woman's doing!」
lines.40: 「Do not interrupt while someone is speaking.」
lines.42: 「Raise your hand if you have something to say.」
lines.46: 「Have we really broken that many school rules?」
lines.47: 「Yeah! We've lived lives as clean as elderly politicians!」
lines.48: 「From what I saw this week alone: running recklessly in the halls, eating in the library, remaining after the permitted departure time, and bringing manga to school.」
lines.49: 「In other words, you are habitual rule-breakers.」
lines.50: 「Therefore, this latest violation cannot be called a moment of weakness. You went about it with considerable practice. Am I wrong?」
lines.53: Her commanding tone had apparently triggered his trauma over his sister.
lines.54: He had one beautiful older sister, but her constant low-grade domestic violence had left him terrified of her.
lines.55: 「But those are all such tiny things. I mean, if you start counting those, you'll never stop.」
lines.56: 「Of course. I do not wish to nag people over every trifle. They are within the range of mistakes most students make, so I overlooked the earlier incidents.」
lines.57: 「This time, however, is different. Late students must enter here, through the main gate's 'Dragon Gate,' and receive a tardy form.」
lines.59: 「Scowling at me will not help. You did something wrong. Am I mistaken?」
lines.64: One idiot was already being trained with candy and the whip.
lines.66: 「Normally, the proper course is for a disciplinary committee member in your own year to caution you. That student, however, said you were already beyond their control.」
lines.67: So they had called in the commander-in-chief.
lines.68: 「That is why I was observing students who appeared likely to cause trouble.」
lines.69: 「Even setting aside my position on the committee, I am older than you. Is it not a senior student's duty to set her juniors straight?」
lines.71: 「You there, the small one. You look deeply dissatisfied.」
